summary: Implemented two fixes: (1) on agent_settled, the server pool now calls clearQueue() to recover any steered messages left stranded by a run that died before reaching its next model call and emits them as a new session.unsent event; the client reducer accumulates them on the store, clears them on session/project/connection resets, and the Composer drains them via a new takeUnsent() helper, merging them into the per-session draft and showing a warning toast; (2) when an assistant turn ends as an interrupted (stopped) message, session-transcript marks it with interrupted: true, the reducer propagates that to the message, and MessageGroup renders a 'Response interrupted' status line.
decisions: Server emits a new 'session.unsent' event (steering+followUp merged, trimmed) on agent_settled via session.clearQueue() rather than exposing queue state as a generic session property, so the client only learns about stranded text when a run actually settles.

Unsent messages live in store.unsent (cleared alongside store.messages on connection/project/session resets) and are drained by a new store.takeUnsent() that empties the array atomically, so the composer restore is a one-shot effect rather than re-running on every store update.

Restored unsent messages are prepended to the existing per-session draft (joined with blank lines) and accompanied by a 'warning' toast explaining the message was never delivered, instead of silently re-queuing to the composer.

Interrupted turns are persisted by setting interrupted: true on the assistant ConversationMessage in session-transcript and surfaced by MessageGroup as a 'Response interrupted' role=status line with a CircleSlash icon, distinguishing aborted runs from completed ones.
